title: Complexity/erosion measurement rules (trellis-fbc5)
rationale: Scoring (trellis-00d5) and the audit core (trellis-ef85) consume these metrics; the decision table and state rules must stay stable so measurements remain reproducible and hand-calculable (SPEC 5.1-5.2).

title: Duplication method (trellis-5a91): own normalized-token detector, jscpd rejected
rationale: SPEC §5.3 records the decision and evaluation. Own impl = zero new deps, shared-parse leaf-token walk (raw ts.createScanner mis-tokenizes template literals — reproduced), type-1+2 semantics, content-identity groups, per-source-set, budget-guarded incomplete. jscpd 5.2.1 = subprocess-only Rust platform binary, pairs not groups, type-1 default, threaded+timestamped; jscpd 4.3.0 = unmaintained, fails to import under Bun (colors CJS interop), 118 transitive pkgs, type-1 only. Thresholds provisional: 50 tokens AND 3 lines; trellis-e924 calibrates. Expected fixture outputs live in trellis-6e4c.

name: Normalized-token clone detection over the shared parse
description: Duplication analyzer (src/metrics/duplication*.ts, trellis-6e4c): leaf-token walk of the shared ts.SourceFile (iterative stack, EOF dropped), identifiers+ literals each to one placeholder; rolling-hash K=50 windows per source set (never cross-file), pairwise maximal extension verified token-by-token, groups merged by content identity (same length bucket + verified equal), same-file-contained members dropped, fully-contained groups subsumed-dropped. Numerator = union of code-classified lines in member ranges per file; denominator = scope code lines. Budgets (2M tokens, 100M comparisons) trip incomplete via a latching WorkState counter threaded through every comparison loop. Biome cognitive-complexity cap 15 forced splitting extend/detect into small helpers; file-size budget 400 forced a 3-way module split (contract+tokens / detect / groups).
